notes:
Summary: IronQuill is building an IntelliJ/PyCharm-first code assistant for enterprise teams. Primary ask: a JetBrains plugin that performs low-latency streaming completions and uses a local on-disk index for workspace/project search. UX must feel native (completion suggestions inline, hover docs, code actions).

Key technical constraints / customer language: 
- "local-first" — source files and index must stay on customer VPC or on-prem; no source push to hosted models unless explicitly allowed.
- Model pinning per workspace: devs want to pin stable model versions for reproducible completions across team.
- Offline / air-gapped mode: ability to run the plugin with on-prem inference (Redwood Private) and local index only.
- Streaming: token streaming latency target <50ms for intra-line completions; observed 25–40ms in POC on dedicated GPUs when KV cache warm.
- Indexing: incremental file-system indexing + language-aware tokens; heavy repos produce ~8–12 GB index, customer asked for encrypted index-at-rest and per-workspace KMS keys.
- Security: SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning required; audit logs for completions and indexing operations; retention controls for logs and persisted prompts.

User quotes/feedback (paraphrased):
- "If the completions go to the cloud we need a strong justification — security team will block otherwise." — Head of Platform
- "Pinning model versions is non-negotiable for our release branch stability." — Engineering manager

POC findings / notes:
- IDE integration: plugin runs as a background service, communicates with local inference endpoint via Unix socket; JetBrains plugin signing required for org-wide rollout.
- Performance: autoscaling dedicated workers reduced cold-starts; prefix caching yielded 35% fewer tokens sent to model vs baseline.
- UX: devs want settings per-project + global defaults; need a simple toggle for 'send snippets to hosted inference' vs 'local-only'.

Commercial / procurement:
- Interested in Redwood Dedicated for mixed workload (hosted for public sample completions, dedicated/private for sensitive repos).
- Contract ask: annual reserved capacity, optional burst, enterprise SLA (99.9) and faster security onboarding.

Next steps (short):
- SE (Priya) to deliver detailed SSO/KMS design doc (due 2025-01-17).
- Legal to review open model licensing impact (blocking for hosted model fallback).
- AE to confirm JetBrains marketplace listing plan and plugin signing timeline.

Stated blockers: plugin signing + legal on model licensing + encrypted local index key management.
demo_feedback: Positive on latency and inline completion; security concerns remain high. Need explicit KMS flow and retention controls.
poC_notes: Installed on 5 dev machines (IntelliJ 2023.3 and PyCharm 2024.1), one node used as local inference with q4-quantized model. Streaming stable, minor token truncation edge cases with long identifiers.
final_comment: High technical fit; procurement will move once security questionnaire answered and plugin signing path clarified. Potential mid-market ARR if Dedicated reserved capacity selected.
